P-15-R1.new_model: Analytical vibration energy model: E = 0.5 * m * v² * f * η. For implantable context: m=1g, v=0.1mm/s, f=10Hz, η=0.1 → E ≈ 0.5 μW (MODELLED).
P-15-R1.uncertainty: Vibration amplitude and frequency highly patient-dependent. ±50% uncertainty on power output.
P-15-R1.falsification_threshold: Sustained power output ≥ 5 μW for 30 days (sufficient for pacemaker-grade operation)

P-22-R1.new_model: Hydraulic actuation model: F = P * A. For 2mm catheter: A = π * (1mm)² = 3.14 mm². At P = 2 atm: F = 6.3 N (sufficient for navigation). Response time ≈ 0.5s (MODELLED).
P-22-R1.uncertainty: Hydraulic response time (0.5s) may be slower than SMP (0.1s). Control loop stability unknown.

P-27-R1.new_model: Metallic reinforcement model: kink threshold = E * I / R. For stainless steel 304: E=193 GPa, I=π*d⁴/64 for d=0.5mm. Kink threshold ≈ 5x standard silicone (MODELLED).
P-27-R1.uncertainty: Metallic tubing is a known approach (US5601539A exists). Novelty is in specific helical geometry. Manufacturing tolerance ±10%.
P-27-R1.falsification_threshold: Kink threshold > 2x standard AND lumen patency > 80% after 10K bending cycles
